# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 - 2026-11-04

- First version in this marketplace: the Box skills and rule, copied from https://github.com/box/skills at commit `84320fd`.
- Skill and rule files are unchanged from the vendor's.
- The vendor's plugin-level files (`.claude-plugin/`, `.github/`, `README.md` and similar) are not included. BoldCreate Connect delivers only skills, agents, rules and hooks.
- The vendor's `mcp.json` is not included.
